meta.description: Plans and audits use of ChicagoHAI HypoGeniC/HypoRefine for LLM-assisted hypothesis generation from labeled text datasets. Use for the hypogenic package, its task configs, hypothesis banks, or HypoBench datasets—not for manual hypothesis formulation or scientific validation.

scientific_integrity.detail: Clear boundaries: output is candidate textual hypotheses and task-prediction statistics, not experimental confirmation or causal evidence; requires independent scientific validation

practice_boundaries.detail: Appropriate scope for HypoGeniC software use; explicitly distinguishes from manual hypothesis formulation (hypothesis-generation skill) and downstream validation

methodological_ground.detail: Based on ChicagoHAI research framework; clearly states predictive accuracy assesses task utility not mechanism truth; independent validation required

code_usability.detail: 5 bundled deterministic, local-only validation tools; never imports hypogenic, contacts models, or executes dataset text

functional_suitability.note: Comprehensive coverage of config validation, dataset audits, run planning, output inspection, and evaluation; 5 bundled tools; minor: actual HypoGeniC CLI integration examples limited

reliability.note: Perfect: exact version pin (hypogenic==0.3.5), SHA-256 checksums for wheel and source, lockfile guidance, and PyPI provenance linking

performance_context.note: Well-structured 291-line SKILL.md with 6 reference files; clear safety gates; minor: density could be improved with more reference delegation

agent_usability.note: Strong trigger description with specific HypoGeniC/HypoBench patterns; clear scope boundaries; minor: no explicit 'When NOT to Use' section

human_usability.note: Excellent installation with uv, SHA-256 verification, pinned dependencies, and isolation guidance; comprehensive pre-run safety checklist

security.note: Perfect: dataset/prompt text treated as untrusted, split preservation enforced, provider privacy gate documented, credentials never logged, bundled tools network-free

maintainability.note: Good structure with version 1.1, license, compatibility; upstream source verification documented; minor: no skill changelog reference

agent_specific.note: Good composability with clear safety gates; 5 bundled validation tools; progressive disclosure with 6 references; minor: workflow orchestration could be more explicit, cost estimation is manual

key_strengths: Perfect reliability with exact version pinning (hypogenic==0.3.5), SHA-256 checksums for wheel and source, and PyPI provenance verification
Exceptional security posture: dataset/prompt text as untrusted, split preservation, provider privacy gate, credentials never logged, 5 bundled network-free tools

Comprehensive pre-run safety workflow: config validation, dataset audit with split leakage detection, cost planning, approval gates before external calls
